summary: Two out-of-state mountain bikers lost/stranded in the North Fruita Desert recreation area (18 Road area) near Fruita; the Mesa County SAR ATV team rescued them on a Friday night.
location: North Fruita Desert recreation area (18 Road), Fruita
responding_agency: Mesa County Search and Rescue (ATV team)
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE (day-of-week derived): the 2017-10-16 Rattlesnake Arches story (updated 2017-10-16, verified Monday) says the MCSAR ATV team 'recently made a trip to Fruita on Friday night' rescuing two out-of-state bikers; Friday before = 2017-10-13.
